title: GEECRACK MAGNUM CUE BOMB | Product Review
description:
The all new Geecrack Magnum Cue Bomb is here! A favorite bait of mine, the Geecrack mag cue bomb is a large urchin style bait that I have been using for months now to target and catch big bass in central Fl and even win a couple tournaments with!

This XL sized Cue Bomb from the Japanese bait masterminds at Geecrack gets a lot of attention from big bass!
